Reviews of the faculty I took this semester
Soc 101- SQL
He is good for learning and his classes are also not boring. He cares for the students. Takes 3 quizzes and counts the best one.

CEE209- NEM
She’s alright for learning. But her classes are so bad. She doesn’t mark for attendance. So not even 10% students attend her classes. She can’t handle her own class and will always nag for it which is very annoying.
Takes 5 quizzes counts best 2. Mid was very hard.But she favors the ones who are regular in her class and interacts. So if you put a little effort, it’s easy to get an A under her.
CEE110- snf
She’s good. She’s very strict but good for learning. You’d have to buy equipments and be on time always as she is very strict about them. But it’s quite easy to get A/A- under her.
Mat120- MTM
I really felt for the good reviews of him. Imo he is “the worst faculty in nsu”. I would give him a 0/100 for learning. Doesn’t do a single math in board. He is very energetic and loud.
Addresses the female students as “baby” and “khalamoni” which is wired. Makes a specific political party biased jokes which are not okay to do. Ships every other female and male students sitting next to each other in class which is disrespectful. He just reads the slides and doesn’t teach any maths.
